reviews.title: Great used 4080 super to save a few bucks
reviews.comment: Received the product in good condition. I have been using it for a little over a week, it runs and performs as it should. No issues receiving, installing or using the product would recommend.
reviews.author: Marc

reviews.title: Used 4080 Super, and I was skeptical but...
reviews.comment: Bought this card used and in "Excellent" condition, and while it has a little coil whine, the card was legitimate, and in great shape! All benchmark tests came back as expected of such a card. While it did not come in the original box, as was stated as a possibility, it otherwise had all typical components and manuals. I'm happy with the purchase, and will update if anything changes.
reviews.author: JC

reviews.title: DON'T BE PESSIMISTIC, TROUBLESHOOT
reviews.comment: Put it in the CPU x16 , didn't work, had a heart attack, stressed all day about it wondering if I had gotten scammed or if this was an error they caused when refurbishing. Then I reseated the CPU, all gone, works perfectly haha
reviews.author: Aaron Hilario
